info.name: Net profit
info.definition: Revenue collected, less project costs, supplier bills and running costs paid, and payroll. Revenue: the fee part of what was collected. Costs: what was paid, except payroll, which counts in the month it is for. Payroll counts only for months whose payroll is confirmed; otherwise the figure says "payroll not confirmed".
info.formula: F1 − project costs paid − vendor bills paid − confirmed payroll − running costs paid
info.source: Payments, project expenses, vendor bills, payroll, operating expenses

info.name: Cash collected (incl. tax and pass-through)
info.definition: Money received in the period, the whole of each payment -- tax and pass-through included, so it is more than the revenue collected -- against what was invoiced in it, with the balance overdue at the period's end.
info.formula: collected (fee + pass-through + tax) · invoiced · overdue balance at the end

info.name: Client and project margin
info.definition: Fee earned in the period less the cost of the period (hours at cost rate, overhead, project costs), as a share of the fee earned. Not judged until a one-off project has logged the share of its estimate set in Settings.
info.source: Fees, retainers terms, time entries, cost rates, project costs

info.name: Revenue at risk
info.definition: The monthly fee of retainers past their renewal date with no renewal deal, ending within the next 60 days with no renewal deal, or being renegotiated with no renewal deal. Any one with an open renewal deal is in renewal, listed beside them and left out of this total.
info.formula: Σ monthly fee of those retainers
info.period: From today on; the period picker does not change it.
